name: Ark UI
summary: Headless accessible components for React (also Vue, Solid, Svelte) with interactive docs demos.
gaps: Headless/unstyled — Basic examples reference CSS modules (styles/*.module.css) and sometimes lucide-react icons.
Pilot includes 12 of 52 documented components (React docs).
Also supports Vue, Solid, Svelte — catalog frameworks list React primary only.
Distinct from Park UI (styled Ark + Panda) already in SoT.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.copyCode:

import { Dialog } from '@ark-ui/react/dialog'

import { XIcon } from 'lucide-react'
import button from 'styles/button.module.css'

        </Dialog.Content>
      </Dialog.Positioner>
    </Portal>
  </Dialog.Root>
)
